layers.name: Next.js 16 App Router & Route Layouts
layers.description: App Router pages, layouts, middleware, route guards, and workspace shell entry points (src/app/).

layers.name: Core Design System (@core/ui/* & Nexus Tokens)
layers.description: Mandatory @core/ui/* shared primitives, Nexus dark/light theme tokens, cards, tables, forms, and dialogs (src/core/ui/ & src/core/components/).

layers.name: Core Kernel, DI Container, IApiService & Hooks
layers.description: Frontend IoC container, IApiService HTTP client, PBAC permission hooks (use-permission), i18n engine, and global stores (src/core/).

layers.name: Module: CRM & Commercial Pipeline Portal
layers.description: CRM sub-modules (leads, opportunities, pipelines, contacts, accounts, activities, quotes) following strict View -> ViewModel -> Repository -> Service flow.

layers.name: Module: Venue, Courts & Booking Operations
layers.description: Venue topology, interactive court calendar, booking wizard, conflict resolution, and facility management sub-modules.

layers.name: Module: Admin, Identity, Roles & Tenants
layers.description: Multi-tenant administration, users, RBAC/PBAC permission matrices, security policies, and audit logs.

layers.name: Module: Billing, Editions, Subscriptions & Quotas
layers.description: SaaS edition management, tenant entitlements, usage quota meters, invoices, and payment workflows.

layers.name: Module: CustomFields & Dynamic Form Studio
layers.description: Dynamic custom field builder, schema definitions, validation rules, and runtime field renderers.

layers.name: Module: PartyKernel & Unified Directory
layers.description: Individual, athlete, household, and organization 360-degree profile views and relationship graphs.

layers.name: Module: HRMS, Staff Directory, Shifts & Leave
layers.description: Employee profiles, coach assignments, shift scheduling, attendance logs, and leave approval workflows.

layers.name: Module: Marketplace & Partner Catalog
layers.description: Partner listings, service discovery, vendor onboarding, and booking checkout views.

layers.name: Module: WorkManagement, Tasks &Kanban Boards
layers.description: Facility tasks, operational checklists, Kanban boards, and SLA deadline trackers.

layers.name: Module: Media Library & Secure Asset Manager
layers.description: Multi-tenant asset browser, drag-and-drop uploaders, image previews, and storage quota indicators.

layers.name: Module: Plugins, Webhooks & Extensions UI
layers.description: Plugin marketplace, tenant extension configuration, and webhook delivery logs.

layers.name: Module: Analytics & Executive KPI Dashboards
layers.description: Real-time operational charts, revenue telemetry, court utilization heatmaps, and cohort analytics.

layers.name: Shared Utilities, Vitest Suites & Tooling Config
layers.description: Shared helpers (src/modules/shared/), unit/component tests (src/test/), and Next.js/Tailwind/TypeScript configs.
